load("../data/RainData.RData")

## Question 1

**1.1 Distribution of annual rainfall**

```{r}
#| label: eda-rain
#| fig-height: 4
#| 
annees <- c(1973, 1974, 1980)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (an in annees) {
  dati_an <- dati |> 
    dplyr::filter(anno == an)
  
  cat("\n=== Année :", an, "===\n")
  print(summary(dati_an$totanno))
  cat("SD:", sd(dati_an$totanno, na.rm = TRUE), 
      "| CV:", sd(dati_an$totanno, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(dati_an$totanno, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  hist(dati_an$totanno, 
       breaks = 20, 
       col = "grey80", 
       main = paste("Histogram -", an), 
       xlab = "Annual rainfall (mm)")
  
  boxplot(dati_an$totanno, 
          main = paste("Boxplot -", an), 
          ylab = "mm")
}

par(op)

```

**1.2 Rainfall vs elevation**

```{r}
#| label: eda-rain
#| fig-height: 4

# 1973
ggplot(dati73, aes(Quota, totanno)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "firebrick") +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Annual rainfall (mm)",
       title = "Rainfall vs elevation, 1973")

# correlation measures and tests
ct_p <- cor.test(dati73$Quota, dati73$totanno, method = "pearson")
ct_p

# simple linear model
fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = dati73)
summary(fit_lm)
confint(fit_lm)

# 1974

ggplot(data_1974, aes(Quota, totanno)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "firebrick") +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Annual rainfall (mm)",
       title = "Rainfall vs elevation, 1974")

# correlation measures and tests
ct_p <- cor.test(data_1974$Quota, data_1974$totanno, method = "pearson")
ct_p

# simple linear model
fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = data_1974)
summary(fit_lm)
confint(fit_lm)

# 1980

ggplot(data_1980, aes(Quota, totanno)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "firebrick") +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Annual rainfall (mm)",
       title = "Rainfall vs elevation, 1980")

# correlation measures and tests
ct_p <- cor.test(data_1980$Quota, data_1980$totanno, method = "pearson")
ct_p

# simple linear model
fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = data_1980)
summary(fit_lm)
confint(fit_lm)
```

```{r}
#| label: lm-diagnostics
#| fig-height: 5

# 1973

fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = dati73)

shapiro.test(residuals(fit_lm))

# is there leftover spatial structure in the residuals?
dati73$res_lm <- residuals(fit_lm)
vr <- variogram(res_lm ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = dati73)
plot(vr, main = "Semivariogram of the residuals of totanno ~ Quota")


# 1974

fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = data_1974)

shapiro.test(residuals(fit_lm))

# is there leftover spatial structure in the residuals?
data_1974$res_lm <- residuals(fit_lm)
vr <- variogram(res_lm ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = data_1974)
plot(vr, main = "Semivariogram of the residuals of totanno ~ Quota")


# 1980

fit_lm <- lm(totanno ~ Quota, data = data_1980)

shapiro.test(residuals(fit_lm))

# is there leftover spatial structure in the residuals?
data_1980$res_lm <- residuals(fit_lm)
vr <- variogram(res_lm ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = data_1980)
plot(vr, main = "Semivariogram of the residuals of totanno ~ Quota")
```

**1.4 Empirical semivariogram**

```{r}
#| label: variogram-envelope
#| fig-height: 4.5

# 1973

v <- variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = dati73)
v 
# Monte Carlo envelope under spatial independence: permute the values over the stations
set.seed(1973)
nsim <- 99
sims <- replicate(nsim, {
  tmp <- dati73
  tmp$totanno <- sample(tmp$totanno)
  variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = tmp,
            cutoff = max(v$dist) / 0.95 * 0.95, width = v$dist[2] - v$dist[1])$gamma[seq_len(nrow(v))]
})
env <- data.frame(dist = v$dist, gamma = v$gamma,
                  lo = apply(sims, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE),
                  hi = apply(sims, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(env, aes(dist / 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(y = gamma)) + geom_line(aes(y = gamma)) +
  labs(x = "Distance (km)", y = "Semivariance",
       title = "Empirical semivariogram vs envelope under no spatial correlation; 1973")

# 1974

v <- variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = data_1974)
v 
# Monte Carlo envelope under spatial independence: permute the values over the stations
set.seed(1974)
nsim <- 99
sims <- replicate(nsim, {
  tmp <- dati73
  tmp$totanno <- sample(tmp$totanno)
  variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = tmp,
            cutoff = max(v$dist) / 0.95 * 0.95, width = v$dist[2] - v$dist[1])$gamma[seq_len(nrow(v))]
})
env <- data.frame(dist = v$dist, gamma = v$gamma,
                  lo = apply(sims, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE),
                  hi = apply(sims, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(env, aes(dist / 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(y = gamma)) + geom_line(aes(y = gamma)) +
  labs(x = "Distance (km)", y = "Semivariance",
       title = "Empirical semivariogram vs envelope under no spatial correlation; 1974")


# 1980


v <- variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = data_1980)
v 
# Monte Carlo envelope under spatial independence: permute the values over the stations
set.seed(1980)
nsim <- 99
sims <- replicate(nsim, {
  tmp <- dati73
  tmp$totanno <- sample(tmp$totanno)
  variogram(totanno ~ 1, locations = ~ XUTM + YUTM, data = tmp,
            cutoff = max(v$dist) / 0.95 * 0.95, width = v$dist[2] - v$dist[1])$gamma[seq_len(nrow(v))]
})
env <- data.frame(dist = v$dist, gamma = v$gamma,
                  lo = apply(sims, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE),
                  hi = apply(sims, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(env, aes(dist / 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(y = gamma)) + geom_line(aes(y = gamma)) +
  labs(x = "Distance (km)", y = "Semivariance",
       title = "Empirical semivariogram vs envelope under no spatial correlation; 1980")


```
